EL.stream: CODE6:508e reads position, placement word, channel word, 32-bit mask for version >6; older default mask 15
EL.create: CODE6:5182 filters before count; capacity 12; layer 16
EL.art: Group 3400, background channel frame 0..2; contact indicator 3+2*channel idle, +1 occupied; background destruction frame 9
EL.contact: WACheckElevators cc76 compares first visible original-outline hit with saved actor index; new contact before old release; no occupancy hold logic
EL.activation: ELActivate 5250 calls DOActivateUpDown for every entering eligible actor even if another actor already occupies control; occupancy count controls indicator only
EL.dotChannels: ((flagsRaw & 0x300)>>8)-1 gives -1 none, 0..2 channels; flag 0x4000 selects initially lowered state when channel enabled
EL.toggle: DOActivateUpDown 4d80 reverses ongoing motion, clamps endpoint reversals, or starts toward opposite endpoint. All 88 source slots inspected for matching saved channel.
EL.reset: ELReset 4fae restores every active record, zero occupancy and idle indicators. DOReset 2220 invokes DOInitUpDownInfo 332e for each up/down dot; shared clocks persist.

upDown.phase: 0 lowered through 12 raised; twelve one-unit callback moves for a full transition, with early reversal possible
upDown.clock: DO uses WA class 1 timer via 35a6/ef94 and callback 262e; rate is source clock-derived, not measured native duration
upDown.permission: Lowering from phase 12 clears human +0x11; reaching 12 raises it. Nonhuman +0x10 is independent. Initial lowered initialization moves/hides sprites but does not explicitly clear +0x11 in 33a6..345a; preserve source lookup/position gates rather than deriving permission solely from visibility.
upDown.riders: 28b2/2902 invokes DOPositionAllRiders during every step, including PU/DP rider updates; static-dot adapters insufficient
upDown.visibility: Main/shadow visible only phase >=2 during motion. Auxiliary layer 4 visible below phase 6 using frame 158-phase; layer 5 channel animation freezes below raised endpoint.
upDown.endpoint: At phase 0 invoke WAOrphanOccupants(dot,-1) then DPOrphanOccupants(dot). Human pivot occupant triggers RODied reason 38; enemies blink until strict adjusted deadline then hide; DP occupants hide/detach.
upDown.orphan: WAOrphan eb46 stores latchedTick+MTAdjustPeriod(15); WAEnemyFrame da22 tests strict > then hides/clears orphan and resurrection deadline; before deadline toggles visibility each callback.
upDown.art: Group 300 and shadow 4100 descriptors 125..158; animated channel ranges 127..134, 136..143, 145..152; hidden initialization parks preceding frame 126/135/144; auxiliary 153..158. Metadata only extracted.
upDown.auxiliaryClock: Layer 5 channel decoration uses unscaled 160, source DOInit 20f6..2102 and misc table type 3. Position changes use WA class 1 timer; clocks must stay separate.
